name: Dcm Shriram Industries Ltd.
summary: DCM Shriram Industries Limited produces and sells sugar, alcohol, power, chemicals, industrial fibers and defence-related products, serving India, Europe, China, Mexico and other markets. Its three segments cover sugar, industrial fibres and related products, and chemicals. It supplies refined sugar in several forms to food, hospitality and pharmaceutical customers and bulk alcohol such as rectified spirit. It also makes rayon and synthetic yarn.
